title: Replace, Don't Expand: Mitigating Context Dilution in Multi-Hop RAG via Fixed-Budget Evidence Assembly
why_relevant: Proposes a fixed-budget controller that actively replaces distractor passages with gap-closing evidence to mitigate context dilution in multi-hop RAG, directly addressing noisy retrieval and distraction robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on multi-hop QA evidence assembly; does not address adversarial or conflict settings.
